trial_court: Additional District Judge, Charaideo at Sonari (T.S (M) Case No. 112/2016)
case_name: Sri Dhrubajyoti Bharadwaj vs Smti. Meenakshi Bharadwaj
facts_of_case: The parties are husband and wife who got married but the wife started pressurizing the husband to live separately from his parents. The husband refused and the matter went to trial court which decided something. The husband is now appealing that decision.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to lead evidence to establish cruelty.
legal_principles.held: However, in the absence of any evidence being led by the respondent, we have no material before us to arrive at any such conclusion.

legal_principles.principle: The principle of 'living separately from family members' cannot be termed as cruelty.
legal_principles.held: The keeping of the respondent in isolation from the family members of the petitioner and the reluctance to get mix up with the family members of the petitioner, in opinion of this court cannot be termed to be cruelty towards the petitioner.
